title: rosa viscaria var. mentita
intro: Rosa viscaria var. mentita, commonly known as Alpine Rose or Alpine Sweet Briar, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa viscaria var. mentita include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and acting as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
